note: Ordered recovery milestones with evidence + reassessment per crisis; thrive gate stays blocked until all met.

milestones.milestone: Stop-loss in force: loss-making/non-essential spend paused.
milestones.evidenceRequired: owner-noted confirmation the spend/activity is paused.
milestones.reassessment: re-check spend after one cycle.

milestones.milestone: Cash position/runway measured (the real figure — never assumed).
milestones.evidenceRequired: the captured cash/runway figure from the owner's own data.
milestones.reassessment: re-measure runway at the next review.

milestones.evidenceRequired: evidence the corrected step passes; a governed reassessment confirms it worked.
milestones.reassessment: re-check the defect/complaint rate after execution.

milestones.evidenceRequired: vendor/maintenance completion confirmation.
milestones.reassessment: re-check response/resolution after the fix.

milestones.evidenceRequired: evidence the delegation/policy is in place.
milestones.reassessment: re-check owner load after one cycle.

milestones.evidenceRequired: all stabilization criteria evidenced.
milestones.reassessment: owner reviews before any growth step.

rows.stabilizationGate: Stabilization is proven only when: the real cash position/runway is measured and not shrinking, customer/quality issues are validated and corrected with executed-outcome evidence, and no critical unresolved operational or legal/contract risk remains.
rows.thriveGate: Growth / scale / marketing / launch / tender-commitment / discount stays BLOCKED until stabilization is proven AND cost/capacity data exists AND the owner approves — no scale before validation, and no guaranteed outcome is claimed.
